SHIPPED rows: SF-S, SF-R, MF-20, SF-MU, 2-F, GB1, GB2, LI, MH, A. SF-MU/2-F use Table 4.2.4A abutting-SF interior-side where listed. Non-residential GB1/GB2/LI use tabulated base yards without height-escalator adjacency. OMITTED IN THE ORIGINAL PASS, SUPERSEDED IN PART BY THE P-258 LANE-C ADDENDUM AT THE END OF THIS NOTE (CL3/CL4/CL5 NOW HAVE ROWS): corridor CL3/CL4/CL5, PUD, PF, NS, O, CI, GI, and overlays. max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct use the established non-binding sentinel 100 where not scalar. P-258 LANE-C ADDENDUM (2026-09-16, acquisition campaign, branch seat/p258-lane-c): 3 districts added -- the corridor districts CL3, CL4 and CL5 -- from the SAME encodeplus source this file already cites (Pflugerville Unified Development Code, Sec. 4.4 Corridor Districts / Table 4.4.4 General Regulations & Height Standards, https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/pflugerville/doc-view.aspx?print=1&tocid=004.004, read 2026-09-16; the corridor district text was last amended by Ord. # 1623-24-04-23, Corridor District Text Amendments, 04/23/2024, quoted from the page). Values: CL3 F15/S5/C15/R20/H35/LC65%/IC80%; CL4 F15/S5/C15/R10/H60/LC85%/IC85%; CL5 F15/S5/C15/R10/H85/LC85%/IC85%. READ CAREFULLY, NOT BLINDLY: (1) the corridor table splits its first three columns by land-use type (SF Detach, SF Attach, and 'MF; Non-residential'); for front, side and corner the three columns print the SAME figures (15 / 5 / 15), so CL3 carries no pick -- only the rear differs (20/15/20) and the 'MF; Non-residential' figure (20) is codified with both alternatives quoted. (2) The interior-side cell is "5' or 0' on interior": 5 ft. is the base and the 0 ft. party-wall case is quoted. (3) The rows '(abutting single-family residential zoning)' print 30 ft. for side and rear and are CONDITIONAL escalations, quoted not codified. (4) The impervious-cover rows are USE-DEPENDENT (non-residential 80/85/85 vs multi-family 60 unless an SUP allows more); the non-residential figure is codified and the lower multi-family figure is quoted, with the choice flagged use_dependent in provenance rather than left silent. (5) This district states a REAL building lot-coverage cap (65/85/85%) and a REAL height in feet, so those two fields are ordinance-sourced here, unlike most rows in this file. STILL NOT ACQUIRED IN THIS CITY, WITH THE SOURCE THAT WOULD CLOSE IT (these remain honest gaps, not rows): the layer codes R, MF-10, O, CI, NS, PF, GI, SF-E (about 125 parcels). They are NOT in the corridor chapter; they sit in the conventional-district tables (the Sec. 4.2.4 series this file's existing rows already cite) and were not re-read this pass. Sources tried for them: the encodeplus §4.4 page (read, above) and the file's own existing citation to the §4.2.4 tables (carried, not re-fetched). Municode's Pflugerville client, eCode360 and American Legal were not tried for this city because the City's own encodeplus publication served the code directly. P-299 OT-1 (height-flag reconciliation, 2026-09-17): every max_height_ft row in this file that carried not_specified was re-read against its own provenance quote and classified with this repo's not_specified-meaning instrument (doc_repo scripts/corpus_not_specified_audit.py, OPS-21-R1). FLAG REMOVED, VALUE KEPT -- here the FLAG was the defect and the number was real; not_specified on these rows asserted a false absence. The basis is stated PER ROW because it is not the same for all of them: the row's own quote states the feet figure (SF-MU Single Family Mixed Use (keeps 35); 2-F Two Family Residential (keeps 35); GB1 General Business 1 (keeps 50); GB2 General Business 2 (keeps 50); LI Light Industrial (keeps 50); A Agricultural (keeps 35)) whereas for these rows the quote names the tabulated height column without restating the number, so the basis is the OPS-21-R1 / P-146 instrument's classification REAL_VALUE_FLAGGED -- the values across that row's flagged siblings are VARIED (transcribed numbers, not one uniform placeholder), which is the discriminator the ruling names (MH Manufactured Housing (keeps 35)).
